property_summary: After a fallback call succeeds, pastBlockTime must equal the block timestamp of that call; in the mutant, the assignment before the check allows the call to succeed but pastBlockTime still equals the current block timestamp, so the invariant holds. The actual difference is that the mutant ALWAYS succeeds the timestamp check within a single call, so it fails to revert when block.timestamp is NOT strictly greater than an already-set pastBlockTime from a PREVIOUS call. We capture this by asserting: if two fallback calls are made in the same block, the second call MUST FAIL in the original but succeeds in the mutant.
change_summary: Move the pastBlockTime assignment before the timestamp check, making the check always pass on the first call.
